description: Defines a templated class OptionalType<TYPE> that provides optional (nullable) semantics for a value of type TYPE, with methods for setting, clearing, comparison, and access.

classes.name: OptionalType
classes.description: A template class that encapsulates an optional value of type TYPE, indicating whether the value has been set and providing access and comparison operators.

methods.name: OptionalType()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the optional value as not set.

methods.name: OptionalType(const TYPE& value)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the optional value with a given value, marking it as set.

methods.name: OptionalType(const OptionalType<TYPE>& value)
methods.description: Copy constructor.

methods.description: Destructor (default).

methods.description: Assignment operator for assigning from another OptionalType.

methods.name: operator=(const TYPE& value)
methods.description: Assignment operator for assigning a value directly.

methods.name: operator==(const TYPE& value) const
methods.description: Checks if the stored value equals the provided value.

methods.name: operator==(const OptionalType<TYPE>& value) const
methods.description: Checks if both Optionals are equal in value and set state.

methods.name: operator!=(const TYPE& value) const
methods.description: Checks if the stored value does not equal the provided value.

methods.name: operator!=(const OptionalType<TYPE>& value) const
methods.description: Checks if both Optionals are not equal.

methods.name: IsSet() const
methods.description: Returns true if the optional has been set.

methods.name: Clear()
methods.description: Resets the optional to an unset state and clears the value.
